UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: Stores accessibility persona and toolbar preferences for a specific user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user owning these preferences.

highContrast.description: Whether High Contrast Mode is enabled.

dyslexiaFont.description: Whether Dyslexia-Friendly Font (Lexend / Atkinson Hyperlegible) is enabled.

bionicReading.description: Whether Bionic Reading Mode (bolding word prefixes) is enabled.

readingRuler.description: Whether the horizontal Reading Ruler follow bar is active.

fontSize.description: Base font size in pixels (14 to 28).

speechRate.description: Web Speech API synthesis rate (0.5 to 2.0).

preferredLanguage.description: Selected language mode in Multilingual Simplifier.

privacyAccepted.description: Whether user has accepted the Privacy & Security Policy.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preference record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preference record was last updated.

ReadingProgress.title: ReadingProgress
ReadingProgress.description: Tracks user's reading progress, active document, active section, and completed checklist items.

documentId.description: ID of the document being studied.

activeSectionId.description: ID of the last selected chapter/section.

completedCheckpoints.description: Bounded list of completed micro-learning checklist IDs (max 50).

/userPreferences/{userId}.description: Stores accessibility preferences keyed by the authenticated user's UID.

/userPreferences/{userId}/readingProgres.description: Subcollection storing reading progress per document under the parent userPreference.
